anomalies.observed: Net CAN_CIPO connects Module1 pin 44 (GPIO10) to U8 pin 14 (SI) and U9 pin 14 (SI). Net CAN_COPI connects Module1 pin 40 (GPIO9) to U8 pin 15 (SO) and U9 pin 15 (SO).
anomalies.expected: CAN_CIPO should be the controller-in/peripheral-out (MISO) signal, connecting Module1 to the MCP2515 SO pins (pin 15). CAN_COPI should be the controller-out/peripheral-in (MOSI) signal, connecting Module1 to the MCP2515 SI pins (pin 14). This is the convention used for the serial SPI bus (SERIAL_CIPO to SO, SERIAL_COPI to SI).
anomalies.impact: The CAN SPI bus is miswired relative to the net names. Firmware that configures GPIO10 as MISO and GPIO9 as MOSI (following the net names) will fail to communicate with the MCP2515 controllers, as the master's input and output are swapped with the slave's SI and SO pins.

anomalies.observed: R36 has value "24k" but its MPN is "FRC0805J240TSD" and its description is "24Ω". The MPN decodes to 24Ω, not 24kΩ.
anomalies.expected: R36 should be 24kΩ as indicated by its value field, consistent with its role as a bleeder resistor across the PoE output rails VOUTP and VOUTN.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the MPN is used for assembly, a 24Ω resistor will be installed instead of 24kΩ, drawing excessive current from the PoE rails and likely causing overheating or damage.

anomalies.observed: R40 has value "51k" but its MPN is "0805W8F5102T5E", which decodes to 5.1kΩ (5102 = 51 × 10^2). The description field says "51kΩ", matching the value field but not the MPN.
anomalies.expected: R40 should be 51kΩ as indicated by its value and description fields, consistent with its role in the Q8 gate-drive divider.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R40") (value "51k") ... (field (name "MPN") "0805W8F5102T5E") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±1% 51kΩ 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the MPN is used for assembly, a 5.1kΩ resistor will be installed instead of 51kΩ, altering the gate-drive voltage for Q8 and potentially preventing proper turn-on or causing incorrect switching behavior.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies: the CAN SPI CIPO/COPI signals are swapped relative to the MCP2515 SI/SO pins, and two resistors (R36, R40) have MPNs that do not match their intended values, which would cause incorrect assembly and circuit malfunction.
